welcome.title: Know where your allowance goes, before it goes.
welcome.text: Short guides, practice tools and a friendly assistant that help students plan an allowance, part-time pay or scholarship money. Everything runs in your browser and nothing you type is stored or sent anywhere.

quotes.text: A budget is telling your money where to go instead of wondering where it went.

savingsTips.text: Every goal starts small. Try setting aside your savings the day your allowance arrives, before anything else.
